tagline: Find work and hire near you across the UK
description: Find your next opportunity at the touch of a button. Develop your arsenal with our educational content library. Buy and sell on our marketplace, or connect with other business owners, community leaders, jobseekers and more all in one place. Together, we are alwaysgrowingahead!

validation.email: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com
validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number with at least 7 digits
validation.url: Enter a full web address starting with http:// or https://

findWork.title: Find Work
findWork.body: Search live jobs on a map across the UK. Filter by role, location and radius, then reveal employer contacts when you are ready.
findWork.imageAlt: Construction workers on a building site

hire.title: Hire Locally
hire.body: Find nearby workers by skill and availability. View profiles and connect directly — no agencies, no delay.
hire.imageAlt: Handshake between an employer and a worker

learn.title: Learn and Train
learn.body: Watch short videos and lectures, and download PDF guides from the education library to grow your trade skills.
learn.imageAlt: Welder at work developing a trade skill

marketplace.title: Buy and Sell
marketplace.body: List tools, PPE, materials and services, or browse what tradespeople near you have for sale.
marketplace.imageAlt: Set of trade tools ready to buy or sell

content.title: Create and Engage
content.body: Post photos and videos to the feed, then like, comment and share with other workers and employers.
content.imageAlt: Tradesperson creating content on a laptop in a workshop
